user.title: Create a key-value store
user.description: Choose a unique store name, such as my_store1. Use lowercase letters, numbers and underscores, starting with a letter. Re-adding a previously removed store restores its saved data.

error.invalid_name: Use 1–64 lowercase letters, numbers or underscores, starting with a letter.

init.description: This setting applies to the shared KV Storage panel for all stores and users. Hiding the sidebar link keeps /kv_storage, sensors, and services available.

abort.integration_not_loaded: KV Storage is not loaded. Load the integration before changing its settings.
